title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 23: eating with rulers, fleeting riches, discipline, and the woes of wine.

questions.text: What should a man given to appetite do when he sits to eat with a ruler?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:1-2 says when you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you, and put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

answers.text: Put a knife to his throat

questions.text: What do riches do, according to this chapter's warning not to weary yourself to be rich?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:4-5 says don't weary yourself to be rich, for riches certainly sprout wings like an eagle and fly in the sky.

answers.text: They sprout wings like an eagle

questions.text: Why should you not speak in the ears of a fool?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:9 says don't speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

answers.text: For he will despise the wisdom of your words
For he will repeat it to everyone
For he will answer with insults
For he will twist your words

questions.text: Why should you not encroach on the fields of the fatherless?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:10-11 says don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless, for their Defender is strong; he will plead their case against you.

answers.text: For the king will punish you
For your own fields will fail
For the elders will curse you

questions.text: What does this chapter say punishing a child with the rod will do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:13-14 says if you punish him with the rod, he will not die; punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

answers.text: Teach him to fear the king

questions.text: What does this chapter say will happen to the drunkard and the glutton?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:20-21 says the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

answers.text: They shall be driven from the city

questions.text: What does this chapter say about your mother when she is old?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:22 says listen to your father who gave you life, and don't despise your mother when she is old.

answers.text: Care for her in your house

questions.text: What does this chapter say to do with the truth?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:23 says buy the truth, and don't sell it; get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

answers.text: Buy it, and don't sell it

questions.text: What is a prostitute compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:27 says a prostitute is a deep pit, and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

questions.text: What does wine do in the end, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:31-32 says don't look at the wine when it is red, for in the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.
